identity.name: Pilot's Watch Mark XVIII
identity.one_liner: The predecessor pilot's watch IWC replaced with the Mark XX in 2022, built around a simplified date-only dial and a Sellita-based automatic movement.

narrative.story: The Mark XVIII simplified its predecessor's dial by dropping the small-seconds sub-register in favor of a clean three-hand-and-date layout, running on an ETA/Sellita-based automatic movement rather than an in-house caliber. IWC discontinued it in 2022 when the Mark XX launched with an in-house movement and a return to a small-seconds layout closer to the original 1948 Mark 11.
narrative.collector_notes: Because it was IWC's entry-level pilot's watch for years, Mark XVIII supply on the secondary market is deep; condition and box/papers completeness matter more to price than rarity does.
